title_en: 1st Next-Generation Engineering Researchers Alumni Symposium 2026 (Promotional Notice)
summary: The SeAH Haiam Academic Scholarship Foundation is holding the 1st Next-Generation Engineering Researchers Alumni Symposium 2026. Students interested in the foundation's talent pipeline support programme are encouraged to take an interest and participate. The notice gives no date, venue or registration procedure.
applies_to: Students interested in the SeAH Haiam Academic Scholarship Foundation's talent pipeline support programme. Participation is voluntary; this is a promotional notice.
conditions: Participation is optional; this is a promotional notice, not a requirement.
The notice does not state the symposium date, venue, eligibility details or how to register.
translation:
[Promotion] Information on the 1st Next-Generation Engineering Researchers Alumni Symposium 2026

The SeAH Haiam Academic Scholarship Foundation (세아해암학술장학재단) is holding the "1st Next-Generation Engineering Researchers Alumni Symposium 2026" (제1회 차세대 공학연구자 Alumni 심포지엄 2026). We encourage students who are interested in the foundation's talent pipeline support programme to take an interest and participate.
